what: Step 3 large-plan opt-in is not a real control point
scenario_or_breakage: The plan tells users to reply show full plan before voting begins, but Step 3 immediately continues into the review-budget branch and panel launch with no AskUserQuestion or pause, so a user may not be able to request the full plan before reviewers start
suggested_fix: Add an explicit summary-mode-only AskUserQuestion before reviewer dispatch, with Launch review and Show full plan first options, or otherwise print the full plan automatically at Step 3 when summary mode would hide body content

what: Large-plan rendering is specified twice without a shared executable contract
scenario_or_breakage: Step 3 gets a concrete Bash block while Gate C gets prose to reimplement the same threshold, counts, outline cap, note text, env validation, and opt-in behavior; future edits can easily make the two visibility gates diverge
suggested_fix: Factor the rendering into one reusable helper or design-driver action with a sibling contract and focused tests, then call it from both Step 3 entry and Gate C

what: New LARCH_DESIGN_PLAN_SUMMARY_THRESHOLD env var is changelog-only despite existing canonical env-var docs
scenario_or_breakage: Operators looking at the documented configuration surface will not find the threshold knob, and future config audits can miss or drift the variable because docs/configuration-and-permissions.md is the repo’s env-var authority
suggested_fix: Add docs/configuration-and-permissions.md to the plan and document the variable, default, positive-integer validation, and malformed-value fallback there; keep the changelog entry as release history

what: Files-to-modify omits CHANGELOG.md even though the plan requires a changelog entry
scenario_or_breakage: An implementer following only the Files to modify section can skip the changelog while believing the plan is complete
suggested_fix: Add CHANGELOG.md to Files to modify, and include docs/configuration-and-permissions.md as well if the env-var docs finding is accepted
